lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like structure most visible in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal ridge feature running across the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct luminance gradient with lighter pixels on the dorsal side and shadow in the ventral trough.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated, high-contrast shape is attached above the fourth and fifth gill slits; a dark, curved linear mark is visible superior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical branchial slits with high-contrast posterior margins; the ocular region is visible at the far right edge of the frame.
